_about: Individual honours (List 11 #104). Per-Mochi ribbons/medals: STORED stamps on the individual record (#80; carried in #96's roster section), earned at specific events in a specific individual's life. Architecturally distinct from #69 achievements: those are the RANGER's, are predicates over derived state, and are never stored; honours are the MOCHI's, are stored facts, and travel with the individual through trade (#68) and storage (#106). A stamp without a resolvable earning fact is a data error. The honour LIST (ids, names, icons, thresholds) is OPEN owner content — canon names no ribbon or medal.

accrual.battle: landmark participation — a dojo clear (#30), gauntlet bout (#100), Syndicate set-piece (#99) this individual was in the party for; the clear flag is the Ranger's (#12), the stamp is the Mochi's
accrual.care: thresholds over the individual's own careLog facts (#28: careLog is truth); the care system writes the stamp at the moment the threshold is crossed
accrual.showcase: #78 placements/participation — certifies presentation, never combat (#78's no-battle-state constraint untouched)

stamp_shape.beatRef: #12 flag or production beat where earned, where one exists
stamp_shape.eventRef: pointer to the earning fact: #28 careLog entry | #78 showcase result | battle record (#30/#45/#99/#100) — must resolve
